title: ai-toolkit.config.json
description: Configuration for the ai-toolkit installer. Documents the post-fix shape (no install.strategy — only copy is supported; no install.backup_existing — never implemented). Inline-validated by tests/schema-config.test.mjs (no ajv dependency).

source.description: Path to the canonical source tree (relative to toolkit root).

tools.description: Per-tool configuration. Keys are tool names; values are toolConfig objects.

default_tools.description: Tools targeted when --tools is omitted. Must be a subset of the supported tool set.

install.description: Install-time options. Currently only state_file (where per-project state is recorded).

state_file.description: Path (relative to project root) where per-project state is recorded.
